title.narrative: The joint executive program for the project to operate the Dhalea Dialysis Center in the Republic of Yemen

description.narrative: 77 beneficiaries were provided with health services

A project based on providing renal dialysis services for patients with acute and chronic kidney failure, free of charge, to the residents of Al-Dhalea Governorate in Yemen, in addition to providing nutritional meals to patients during dialysis (each patient performs 13 monthly dialysis sessions for free). The patient also receives health care from a consultant. Internal medicine specializes in kidneys for free, in addition to performing related tests for free. The project includes training activities for health personnel working in the Dhalea Center, in addition to providing job opportunities for them by providing monthly salaries for workers.

Providing the hemodialysis service in accordance with health standards and localizing the service to alleviate the suffering of kidney failure patients and support the steadfastness of the health sector in Al-Dhalea Governorate in the Republic of Yemen. Sub-objectives: Alleviating the suffering of kidney failure patients / saving and preserving their lives by performing hemodialysis for them / improving the center’s performance through the consulting clinic / counting patients and following them up through the database
